newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain estimates Q1 GDP grew up to 2.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Spain estimates Q1 GDP grew up to 2.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Spanish Economy Ministry estimated that first quarter gross domestic product grew up to 2.9 percent compared to the year-ago quarter.
"(GDP) grew up to 2.9 percent in the first quarter. Quarterly annualised growth easily exceeded three percent," according to a report on the economic situation.
GDP growth stems from the acceleration in internal demand to a two percent rate from 1.4 percent in preceding quarter.

"(In 1997) the Spanish economy has raised its rate of growth and job creation, at the same time as it has progressed in the correction of basic imbalances and as uncertainties have disappeared regarding its incorporation into monetary union in 1999," he added.
